title.zh: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九
title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九 Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9

sentences.zh: 三十一年春正月甲戌朔，以日食，不受朝。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: because of a solar eclipse, court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: Year 31, spring, jiaxu new moon: Gaozong canceled audience for the eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雷。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, thunder rolled.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免湖州增丁所輸絹。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the silk paid by Huzhou for added registered households was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huzhou was freed from added-household silk levies.

sentences.zh: 夜，風雷雨雪交作。

translations.literal: At night, wind, thunder, snow, and rain struck together.
translations.idiomatic: That night wind, thunder, snow, and rain came together.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔江、浙官民戶均輸和市絁帛。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: an edict ordered official and common households of Jiang and Zhe to share equally in transport and market purchase of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Jiang and Zhe were told to share silk transport and market purchases equally among official and common households.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，劉寶落節鉞、福建路居住。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Liu Bao was stripped of his command tally and made to reside on the Fujian circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Liu Bao lost his command tally and was sent to live on the Fujian circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大雨雪，給三衙衛士、行在貧民錢及薪炭，命常平振給輔郡細民，諸路監司決獄。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: in great rain and snow, money and fuel were given to the Three Yamaz guards and poor people at the mobile court; the Ever-Normal Granaries were ordered to relieve needy folk in auxiliary commanderies; circuit commissioners were to decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, heavy snow brought cash and charcoal to palace guards and capital poor; Ever-Normal stores fed nearby counties; commissioners judged cases.

sentences.zh: 己亥，放張浚、胡銓自便。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Zhang Jun and Hu Quan were released to go as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhang Jun and Hu Quan were freed to their own devices.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禁淮南拘籍戶馬。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Huainan was forbidden to seize and register household horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Huainan could no longer seize and register civilian horses.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，復置邛州惠民監。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: the Qiongzhou Benefiting-the-People mint was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wushen: the Qiongzhou Benefiting-the-People mint was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以趙密領殿前都指揮使。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhao Mi was made to head the Palace Front Command.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhao Mi took the Palace Front Command.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷楊存中殿前都指揮使，進太傅，為醴泉觀使，封同安郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yang Cunzhong was removed as Palace Front commander, advanced to Grand Preceptor, made commissioner of the Sweet Spring Abbey, and enfeoffed as Prince of Tong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Cunzhong left the Palace Front post for Grand Preceptor, Sweet Spring Abbey commissioner, and Prince of Tong'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，置行在會子務。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the mobile court Bureau of Exchange Notes was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the mobile court set up a Bureau of Exchange Notes.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復鬻僧道度牒。

translations.literal: Day yichou: sale of monk and Daoist ordination certificates was again allowed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the state again sold monk and Daoist ordination slips.

sentences.zh: 詔分經義、詩賦為兩科。

translations.literal: An edict split the classics and poetry composition into two examination subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Classics and poetry were split into separate examination tracks.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔通進司承受內降文字，並囊封送三省、樞密院。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict ordered the Memorial Forwarding Office to receive inner-court descent documents, wrap them, and send them to the Three Departments and Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Memorial Forwarding Office was to pouch inner edicts for the Three Departments and Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秦熺卒，贈太傅。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Qin Xi died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Qin Xi died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌朔，命破敵軍統制陳敏部兵屯太平州。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu new moon: Break-the-Enemy Army controller Chen Min was ordered to station troops at Taiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu new moon: Chen Min of the Break-the-Enemy Army was posted at Taiping.

sentences.zh: 己卯，官勳臣魏仁浦、馬知節、余靖、寇瑊諸孫各一人。

translations.literal: Day jimao: one descendant each of meritorious ministers Wei Renpu, Ma Zhijie, Yu Jing, and Kou Zhen was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, one descendant each of Wei Renpu, Ma Zhijie, Yu Jing, and Kou Zhen received office.

sentences.zh: 選文臣宗室主西、南外兩宗司。

translations.literal: Civil officials of the imperial clan were chosen to head the Western and Southern Outer Clan offices.
translations.idiomatic: Civil clansmen were chosen to head the Western and Southern Outer Clan offices.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禁兩淮抑民附種。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the two Huai circuits were forbidden to coerce people into planting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the two Huai could not force farmers into planting schemes.

sentences.zh: 以利州西路御前諸軍都統制吳拱知襄陽府，部兵三千戍之。

translations.literal: Lizhou West Route overall commander of the imperial front armies Wu Gong was made prefect of Xiangyang and led three thousand troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Gong, overall commander on the Lizhou West Route, became Xiangyang prefect with three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以兵部尚書楊椿參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Minister of War Yang Chun was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yang Chun of the Ministry of War joined the council.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，奪秦熺贈官及遺表恩賞。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Qin Xi's posthumous rank and memorial favors were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Qin Xi's posthumous honors and memorial rewards were revoked.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以陳康伯為尚書左僕射，朱倬右僕射，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Chen Kangbo was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Zhu Chuo Right Vice Director; both Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Chen Kangbo became Left Vice Director and Zhu Chuo Right Vice Director, both Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，復李光左中大夫，官其子孫二人。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Guang was restored as Left Grand Master of the Palace; two of his sons and grandsons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Guang was restored as Left Grand Master; two descendants received posts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，地震。

translations.literal: Day renchen: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前徽猷閣待制張宇發死節，贈四官，錄其子孫。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: former Huizhen Hall awaiting appointment Zhang Yu, who had died loyal, was posthumously advanced four ranks and his sons and grandsons were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Yu—dead in loyal service—won four posthumous ranks and enrollment for his descendants.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以久雨傷蠶麥，盜賊間發，命侍從、台諫條上弭災除盜之策。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: because long rain had harmed silkworms and wheat and bandits had broken out here and there, attendant ministers and remonstrance officers were ordered to submit plans to end disaster and suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingsi: after rains ruined silkworms and wheat and bandits stirred, attendants and remonstrators were told to propose relief and suppression.

sentences.zh: 出天申節銀十萬兩加充戶部糴本。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand taels of Tian Shen festival silver were issued to augment the Ministry of Revenue's grain-purchase capital.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand taels of Tian Shen silver went to the grain-purchase fund.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣周麟之使金賀遷都。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Zhou Linzhi was sent as envoy to the Jin to congratulate their move of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhou Linzhi was sent to the Jin to congratulate their capital move.

sentences.zh: 壬申，權減荊南上供錢銀絹絲米之半，用招填禁軍。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Jingnan's yearly tribute of money, silver, silk, and grain was temporarily halved to recruit and fill the forbidden army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Jingnan's tribute was halved to fill the forbidden army.

sentences.zh: 是月，金主亮率文武群臣如汝、洛。

translations.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing led civil and military officials to Ru and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hailing led his court to Ru and Luo.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉朔，給兩淮民兵荒田。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou new moon: wasteland was granted to Huainan militia.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiyou new moon: Huainan militia received waste fields.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，增築禁城。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the forbidden inner city was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the forbidden inner city was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔吳拱視緩急退守荊南。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict ordered Wu Gong, according to urgency, to withdraw and hold Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wu Gong was told to fall back on Jingnan as needed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命沿淮州郡毋納北人。

translations.literal: Day jichou: prefectures along the Huai were ordered not to accept northerners.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Huai prefectures could not shelter northerners.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金遣高景山、王全來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the Jin sent Gao Jingshan and Wang Quan to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Jin sent Gao Jingshan and Wang Quan for the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 全揚言無禮，致其主亮語，求淮、漢地及指取將相近臣計事，且以欽宗皇帝訃聞。

translations.literal: Quan spoke insolently, delivered Hailing's words, demanded the Huai and Han lands, named generals and nearby ministers for consultation, and also brought word of Emperor Qinzong's death.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan was rude, spoke for Hailing, demanded the Huai and Han, named Song commanders to parley with, and announced Qinzong's death.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，選兩浙、江東、福建諸州禁軍弓弩手之半，部送樞密院按試。

translations.literal: Day renchen: half the forbidden-army crossbowmen of Zhejiang East, Jiangdong, and Fujian were selected and sent to the Privy Council for testing.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, half the crossbowmen of Zhe East, Jiangdong, and Fujian were sent to the Privy Council for trials.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宰執召同安郡王楊存中及三衙帥趙密等至都堂議舉兵。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the chief ministers summoned Prince of Tong'an Yang Cunzhong and the Three Yamaz commanders Zhao Mi and others to the Secretariat hall to discuss raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, councilors called Yang Cunzhong, Zhao Mi, and the Three Yamaz commanders to the Secretariat to plan war.

sentences.zh: 詔以王全語諭諸路統制、帥守、監司，隨宜應變，毋失機會。

translations.literal: An edict conveyed Wang Quan's words to circuit commanders, prefectural commanders, and commissioners, telling them to adapt as fit and not miss the moment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict spread Wang Quan's message to commanders and commissioners: adapt locally and seize the moment.

sentences.zh: 是日，為欽宗皇帝發喪，特詔持斬衰三年。

translations.literal: That day, mourning was held for Emperor Qinzong; a special edict ordered wearing hemmed sackcloth for three years.
translations.idiomatic: That day court mourned Qinzong; a special edict required three years in hemmed sackcloth.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以吳璘為四川宣撫使，仍命制置使王剛中同處置軍事。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Wu Lin was made Sichuan pacification commissioner; Commissioner Wang Gangzhong was also ordered to handle military affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wu Lin became Sichuan pacification commissioner; Wang Gangzhong joined him on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命主管馬軍司成閔部兵三萬人戍鄂州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: director of the Horse Army Bureau Cheng Min was ordered to lead thirty thousand troops to garrison Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Cheng Min of the Horse Army Bureau took thirty thousand men to Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命兩浙、江、湖、福建諸州起禁軍弓弩手，部送明州、平江府、江、池、太平三州、荊南府軍前。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the prefectures of Zhejiang East, Jiang, Hu, Fujian, and others were ordered to raise forbidden-army crossbowmen and send them before the armies at Mingzhou, Pingjiang, Jiang, Chi, Taiping, the three prefectures, and Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhe East, Jiang, Hu, Fujian, and other prefectures sent crossbowmen to Ming, Pingjiang, Jiang, Chi, Taiping, and Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史陳俊卿言，內侍張去為竊權撓政，乞斬之以作士氣。

translations.literal: Palace remonstrance officer Chen Junqing said the eunuch Zhang Quwei had stolen power and meddled in government; he begged execution to stiffen morale.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Junqing urged beheading the eunuch Zhang Quwei for seizing power and meddling in policy.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，以群臣三上表，始聽政。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi: because the ministers had thrice submitted memorials, the Emperor at last held audience.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yisi: after three ministerial pleas, Gaozong at last held audience.

sentences.zh: 丙午，劉錡乞即日移軍渡江，詔錡進發，騎兵屯揚州。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liu Qi begged to move his army across the river that very day; an edict ordered Qi to advance; his cavalry camped at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Liu Qi asked to cross the river at once; ordered forward, his cavalry camped at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，出宮女三百九十人。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: three hundred ninety palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, three hundred ninety palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 蠲臨安府禁軍闕額錢五年。

translations.literal: Shortfall pay for the forbidden army in Lin'an was remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an's forbidden-army shortfall pay was forgiven five years.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以御史中丞汪澈為湖北、京西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Censor-in-Chief Wang Che was made Hu-Bei and Jingxi pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Censor-in-Chief Wang Che became Hu-Bei and Jingxi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金主亮遣大懷正至盱眙，語送伴使呂廣問云：將以六月遷汴京。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Jin ruler Hailing sent Da Huaizheng to Chuyang; he told the escort envoy Lü Guangwen that in the sixth month they would move the capital to Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Hailing sent Da Huaizheng to Chuyang to tell escort Lü Guangwen they would move to Bianjing in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 令其歸奏。

translations.literal: He was told to return and report.
translations.idiomatic: He was told to go back and report.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷教坊，並敕令所歸刑部。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the Music Bureau was abolished and the Edict Office was returned to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Music Bureau was abolished and the Edict Office went back to Justice.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以劉錡為淮南、江東西、浙西制置使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Liu Qi was made commissioner for Huainan, Jiang East and West, and Zhe West.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liu Qi became commissioner for Huainan, Jiang East and West, and Zhe West.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命帶禦器械劉炎同提舉措置沿淮盜賊。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Bearer of the Imperial Armory Liu Yan was made co-director for measures against bandits along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liu Yan of the Imperial Armory co-directed anti-bandit measures along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 庚申，彗出角。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a comet appeared in the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a comet rose in the Horn.

sentences.zh: 遣步軍司都統制戚方提總江上諸軍策應軍馬，聽劉錡節制。

translations.literal: Infantry Bureau overall commander Qi Fang was sent to take overall charge of army horses responding on the river and to obey Liu Qi's command.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Fang of the Infantry Bureau was sent to coordinate river armies under Liu Qi.

sentences.zh: 諭吳拱嚴備襄陽，視緩急，合田師中、成閔兵以援之。

translations.literal: Wu Gong was instructed to ready Xiangyang strictly; according to urgency, he was to combine with Tian Shizhong and Cheng Min to reinforce it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Gong was told to brace Xiangyang and, as needed, join Tian Shizhong and Cheng Min in relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，始禦正殿。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Emperor at last held audience in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Gaozong at last held audience in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，放女樂二百餘人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: more than two hundred female musicians were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, over two hundred female musicians were released.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，聽淮南諸州移治清野。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Huainan prefectures were allowed to move their seats and clear the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Huainan prefectures might shift seats and clear the countryside.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以周麟之辭使北，命樞密都承旨徐嚞代行。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: because Zhou Linzhi declined the northern mission, Privy Council receiver Xu Zhe was sent in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, with Zhou Linzhi refusing the north, Privy Council receiver Xu Zhe went instead.

sentences.zh: 淮北民兵崔唯夫、董臻等率眾萬餘來歸。

translations.literal: North-of-the-Huai militiamen Cui Weifu, Dong Zhen, and others led more than ten thousand to submit.
translations.idiomatic: North of the Huai, Cui Weifu, Dong Zhen, and others brought ten thousand militia in.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，命兩浙、江東濱海諸州預備敵兵。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi: the coastal prefectures of Zhejiang East and Jiangdong were ordered to prepare against enemy troops.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingzi: Zhe East and Jiangdong coasts were told to prepare for the enemy.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路帥臣教閱土兵、弓手。

translations.literal: An edict ordered circuit commanders to drill local soldiers and bowmen.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit commanders were told to drill local soldiers and bowmen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命雷州守臣節制高、容、廉、化四州軍馬。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Leizhou prefect was ordered to command troops of the four prefectures Gao, Rong, Lian, and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Leizhou prefect took command of Gao, Rong, Lian, and Hua troops.

sentences.zh: 時雷州軍賊淩鐵作亂，東南第十二將高居弁會五州巡尉官兵討平之。

translations.literal: At the time the Leizhou garrison bandit Ling Tie was in revolt; Gao Jubian of the Southeast Twelfth Command joined five prefectures' patrol officers and government troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Leizhou rebel Ling Tie was crushed when Gao Jubian of the Twelfth Command joined five prefectures' patrol troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，周麟之分司、筠州居住。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhou Linzhi was given a nominal post and made to reside at Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhou Linzhi took a nominal post and lived at Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，振給淮南歸正人。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: those who had returned to allegiance in Huainan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Huainan returnees were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，徐嚞等至盱眙，金主亮以非所指取之人，諭遣亟還。

translations.literal: Day renchen: when Xu Zhe and others reached Chuyang, the Jin ruler Hailing said they were not the men he had named and ordered them sent back at once.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, at Chuyang Hailing dismissed Xu Zhe's mission—not the envoys he had named—and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔：「四川財賦，自當專任總領所。

translations.literal: Day guisi: an edict said: "Sichuan's wealth and levies should be entrusted solely to the overall revenue office.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, an edict said: "Sichuan revenue belongs solely to the overall revenue office.

sentences.zh: 如遇警急，調發不及申奏，則令宣、制司隨宜措置，先舉後聞。

translations.literal: If in emergency deployment there is no time to memorialize, then let the pacification and commissioner offices act as fit, act first and report after."
translations.idiomatic: In emergencies too urgent to memorialize, pacification and commissioner offices may act first and report after."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，行新造會子於淮、浙、湖北、京西諸州。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: newly minted exchange notes were put into circulation in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, new exchange notes circulated in the Huai, Zhe, Hubei, and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，金主亮徙都汴京，命其臣劉萼由唐、鄧瞰荊、襄，張中彥、王彥章據秦、鳳、窺巴、蜀，蘇保衡、完顏鄭家奴由海道趨兩浙。

translations.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing moved the capital to Bianjing; he ordered his minister Liu E from Tang and Deng to overlook Jing and Xiang; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang to hold Qin and Feng and spy on Ba and Shu; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu by sea toward the two Zhes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hailing moved to Bianjing; Liu E threatened Jing and Xiang from Tang and Deng; Zhang Zhongyan and Wang Yanchang menaced Ba and Shu from Qin and Feng; Su Baoheng and Wanyan Zhengjianu sailed toward Zhe.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑朔，忠義人魏勝復海州，李寶承制以勝知州事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou new moon: loyalist Wei Sheng recovered Haizhou; Li Bao, by provisional order, made Sheng prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou new moon: Wei Sheng retook Haizhou; Li Bao made him prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蠲諸路逋欠經總製錢、江浙等路上供米。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: overdue integrated-funds money and upper-supply grain on Jiang, Zhe, and other circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, overdue integrated funds and upper-supply grain in Jiang and Zhe were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以婉容劉氏妄預國政，廢於家。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: because Palace Lady Liu had presumptuously meddled in state affairs, she was deposed and kept at home.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Palace Lady Liu—who had meddled in state affairs—was deposed and kept at home.

sentences.zh: 蠲淮南、京西、湖北民秋稅之半。

translations.literal: Autumn tax for the people of Huainan, Jingxi, and Hubei was halved.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn tax in Huainan, Jingxi, and Hubei was cut by half.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以劉婉容事連坐，昭慶軍承宣使王繼先福州居住，停子孫官，籍其貲。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: implicated in the Palace Lady Liu affair, Zhaqing Army commissioner Wang Jixian was sent to reside at Fuzhou; his sons and grandsons lost office; his property was registered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Wang Jixian—implicated with Palace Lady Liu—was sent to Fuzhou; his kin lost office and his goods were seized.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，李寶率舟師三千發江陰，大風，退泊明州關澳，聚兵復進。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Li Bao led three thousand warships from Jiangyin; great wind forced them to anchor at Mingzhou's bay; they gathered troops and advanced again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Bao sailed three thousand ships from Jiangyin; storm drove him to Mingzhou bay, then he gathered strength and pushed on.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，劉錡引兵屯揚州，遣統制王剛以兵五千屯寶應。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Liu Qi led troops to Yangzhou and sent controller Wang Gang with five thousand to camp at Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liu Qi camped at Yangzhou and sent Wang Gang with five thousand to Baoying.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，召田師中赴行在。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Tian Shizhong was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Tian Shizhong was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 尋以吳拱為鄂州諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: Soon after, Wu Gong was made overall commander of all armies at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wu Gong became overall commander at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復用資政殿學士張燾落致仕、知建康府。

translations.literal: Day renxu: former Academician Zhang Zhao, though retired, was again used as prefect of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, retired Academician Zhang Zhao was again named Jiankang prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，分處歸正人于淮南諸州，能自存者從便，願為兵者籍之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: returnees in Huainan were settled among its prefectures; those who could support themselves might do as they pleased; those who wished to be soldiers were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Huainan returnees were settled by prefecture; the self-sufficient went freely; volunteers were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔便宜選補戰功人，後勿遞減。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict allowed merit in battle to be filled by expedient selection, not to be reduced step by step afterward.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, battle merit might be rewarded by expedient promotion without later stepwise cuts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，出內帑錢七萬緡，犒戍兵之家，仍悉除軍債。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: seventy thousand strings from the inner treasury were issued to reward garrison households, and all military debt was wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, seventy thousand strings from the inner treasury rewarded garrison families and all military debt was cleared.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，起復成閔為湖北、京西制置使，節制兩路軍馬。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Cheng Min was restored to office and made Hubei and Jingxi commissioner, commanding troops of both circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Cheng Min was restored as Hubei and Jingxi commissioner over both circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，命大臣朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu new moon: great ministers were ordered to offer at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengwu new moon: great ministers offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宗祀徽宗於明堂，以配上帝，大赦。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Emperor Huizong was enshrined in the Bright Hall with the High God as correlate; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Huizong was enshrined in the Bright Hall with the High God; a great amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，金人犯黃牛堡，守將李彥堅拒卻之，金兵遂扼大散關，吳璘駐青野原，遣將高松等援之。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Jin troops attacked Huangniu Fort; defender Li Yanjian repulsed them; the Jin then blocked Dasan Pass; Wu Lin camped at Qingye Plain and sent Generals Gao Song and others to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Jin hit Huangniu Fort and Li Yanjian drove them off; they seized Dasan Pass; Wu Lin camped Qingye Plain and sent Gao Song to help.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以給事中黃祖舜同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Supervising Secretary Huang Zushun was made Associate Privy Council Signatory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Huang Zushun became Associate Privy Council Signatory.

sentences.zh: 壬午，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day renwu: a meteor fell in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔劉錡、王權、李顯忠、戚方嚴備清河、潁河、渦河口。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict ordered Liu Qi, Wang Quan, Li Xianzhong, and Qi Fang to ready Qinghe, Yinghe, and Guohe mouths strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Liu Qi, Wang Quan, Li Xianzhong, and Qi Fang were told to brace Qinghe, Yinghe, and Guo mouths.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，成閔渡江，屯應城縣，遣吳拱戍郢州。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Cheng Min crossed the river and camped at Yingcheng county; he sent Wu Gong to garrison Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Cheng Min crossed to Yingcheng and posted Wu Gong at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 博州民王友直聚兵大名，自稱河北安撫制置使，以其徒王任為副，遣軍師馮穀入朝奏事。

translations.literal: Bozhou commoner Wang Youzhi gathered troops at Daming, styled himself Hebei pacification commissioner, made his follower Wang Ren vice, and sent strategist Feng Gu to court to report.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youzhi of Bozhou raised Daming, called himself Hebei pacification commissioner, made Wang Ren vice, and sent Feng Gu to court.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣將彭青至寶雞渭河，夜劫金人橋頭砦，破之。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent General Peng Qing to the Baoji Wei River; at night he raided the Jin bridgehead fort and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin's Peng Qing reached the Baoji Wei, raided the bridgehead fort by night, and took it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，成閔遣統制趙撙部兵五千駐德安。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Cheng Min sent controller Zhao Zan with five thousand to camp at De'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Cheng Min sent Zhao Zan with five thousand to De'an.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金國趣使臣書至楚州，守臣以聞，其辭多悖慢。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a Jin urgent dispatch reached Chuzhou; the prefect reported it—its wording was mostly insolent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, an insolent Jin dispatch reached Chuzhou and the prefect reported it.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，監盱眙軍淮河渡夏俊復泗州。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Chuyang garrison inspector Xia Jun recovered Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xia Jun of the Chuyang garrison retook Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金人犯通化軍，守將張超拒卻之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Jin troops attacked Tonghua Army; defender Zhang Chao repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Jin hit Tonghua Army and Zhang Chao drove them back.

sentences.zh: 甲午，冊諡大行皇帝曰恭文順德仁孝皇帝，廟號欽宗。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the late emperor was given the temple posthumous title Respectful, Cultured, Accordant, Virtuous, and Filial and the temple name Qinzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the late emperor was styled Respectful, Cultured, Accordant, Virtuous, and Filial with temple name Qinzong.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣將劉海復秦州，金守將蕭濟降。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent General Liu Hai to recover Qinzhou; Jin prefect Xiao Ji submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin's Liu Hai retook Qinzhou; the Jin prefect Xiao Ji surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，金人犯信陽軍。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Jin troops attacked Xinyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Jin attacked Xinyang Army.

sentences.zh: 丙申，吳璘遣將曹㳜復洮州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wu Lin sent General Cao Sui to recover Taozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Wu Lin's Cao Sui retook Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，劉錡發揚州。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Liu Qi marched from Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Liu Qi marched from Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔以金人背盟，降敕榜招諭中原軍民。

translations.literal: An edict, because the Jin had broken the alliance, issued a placard to summon the armies and people of the central plain.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Jin had broken treaty, a placard called the central plain to arms.

sentences.zh: 己亥，蘭州漢軍千戶王宏殺其刺史溫敦烏乜來降。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Wang Hong, a thousand-household chief of the Lanzhou Han army, killed his commissioner Wendun Wuma and came over.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Lanzhou Han officer Wang Hong killed Commissioner Wendun Wuma and defected.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣將彭青復隴州。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent General Peng Qing to recover Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin's Peng Qing retook Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，金主亮以尚書右丞李通為大都督，造浮梁于淮水之上，遂自將來攻，兵號百萬，遠近大震。

translations.literal: That month, the Jin ruler Hailing made Right Vice Director Li Tong grand marshal, built pontoon bridges on the Huai, then came in person to attack; his troops were said to number a million; near and far were greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hailing made Li Tong grand marshal, bridged the Huai, and came himself with a host said at a million; the realm shook.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子朔，詔將親征。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi new moon: an edict said the Emperor would campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengzi new moon: Gaozong announced he would take the field.

sentences.zh: 魏勝攻沂州，敗，還海州，金人圍之。

translations.literal: Wei Sheng attacked Yizhou, was defeated, returned to Haizhou, and the Jin besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sheng attacked Yizhou, lost, fled to Haizhou, and the Jin besieged him.

sentences.zh: 李寶以舟師至東海縣，金人解圍去，寶遂入海州。

translations.literal: Li Bao with his fleet reached Donghai county; the Jin lifted the siege and left; Bao then entered Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao's fleet reached Donghai; the Jin broke the siege; Bao entered Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金人自渦口渡淮。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Jin troops crossed the Huai from Wokou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Jin crossed the Huai at Wokou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以吳璘兼陝西、河東招討使，劉錡兼京東、河北東路招討使，成閔兼京西、河北西路招討使。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wu Lin was also made Shaanxi and Hedong pacification commissioner; Liu Qi also made Hebei East and East-Hebei pacification commissioner; Cheng Min also made Jingxi and Hebei West pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wu Lin also took Shaanxi and Hedong; Liu Qi Hebei East; Cheng Min Jingxi and Hebei West.

sentences.zh: 金人陷蔣州。

translations.literal: Jin troops took Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠遣統制孔福與金人戰于大人洲，敗之。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong sent controller Kong Fu to fight the Jin at Daren Islet and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong's Kong Fu beat the Jin at Daren Islet.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金人復犯海州，魏勝、李寶擊卻之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Jin troops again attacked Haizhou; Wei Sheng and Li Bao beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Jin struck Haizhou again; Wei Sheng and Li Bao repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 劉錡引兵次淮陰，金人將自清河口入淮，錡列兵于運河岸以扼之。

translations.literal: Liu Qi led troops to Huaiyin; the Jin were about to enter the Huai from Qinghe mouth; Qi arrayed troops on the canal bank to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi halted at Huaiyin; as the Jin aimed for Qinghe mouth, he lined the canal to block them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命宣撫制置司傳檄契丹、西夏、高麗、渤海諸國及河北、河東、陝西、京東、河南諸路，諭出師共討金人。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the pacification and commissioner offices were ordered to proclaim to Khitan, Western Xia, Goryeo, Bohai, and the circuits of Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, Jingdong, and Henan, urging them to march and join in attacking the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, pacification offices called on Khitan, Xia, Goryeo, Bohai, and northern circuits to join against the Jin.

sentences.zh: 是日，金人立其東京留守葛王褒為皇帝，改元大定。

translations.literal: That day, the Jin set up their Eastern Capital regent, the Prince of Ge, as emperor and changed the era name to Dad ing.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Jin made Eastern Capital regent Prince of Ge emperor with era Dading.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王權聞金兵大至，自廬州引兵遁，屯昭關。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Quan, hearing the Jin army was great, led troops from Luzhou in flight and camped at Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, hearing the Jin host was vast, Wang Quan fled Luzhou to Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，知均州武钜招納北界杜海等二萬人來歸。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Jun prefect Wu Ju recruited Du Hai and twenty thousand others from north of the border to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Jun's Wu Ju brought in Du Hai and twenty thousand northerners.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復置機速房。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Rapid-Response Office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Rapid-Response Office was restored.

sentences.zh: 知廬州龔濤聞金兵將至，棄城走。

translations.literal: Luzhou prefect Gong Tao, hearing the Jin would come, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou's Gong Tao fled before the Jin arrived.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金將蕭琦陷滁州，守臣陸廉棄城走。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Jin general Xiao Qi took Chuzhou; the prefect Lu Lian abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xiao Qi took Chuzhou; Lu Lian fled.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改建王瑋為鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Prince of Jian was changed to military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Prince of Jian became Zhennan Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 劉錡遣統制王剛等擊敗金人於清河口，金人復來戰，剛失利。

translations.literal: Liu Qi sent controllers Wang Gang and others to defeat the Jin at Qinghe mouth; the Jin came again and Gang was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi's Wang Gang beat the Jin at Qinghe mouth, then lost the rematch.

sentences.zh: 吳拱遣將侯俊、郝敦書復唐州。

translations.literal: Wu Gong sent generals Hou Jun and Hao Dunshu to recover Tangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Gong's Hou Jun and Hao Dunshu retook Tangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，借江、浙、荊湖等路坊場淨利錢三百八十萬緡以備賞軍。

translations.literal: Day guichou: three million eight hundred thousand strings of net profit from Jiang, Zhe, Jinghu, and other circuit market stalls were borrowed to fund army rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, 3.8 million strings of market profit from Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu were borrowed for rewards.

sentences.zh: 金人圍廬州，都監、權州事楊春率兵突陣出，守水砦。

translations.literal: Jin troops besieged Luzhou; garrison inspector and acting prefect Yang Chun led troops in a breakout and held a water fort.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Luzhou; Yang Chun broke out and held a water fort.

sentences.zh: 金人又攻海州，李寶力戰敗之，解圍去。

translations.literal: The Jin again attacked Haizhou; Li Bao fought hard and defeated them; they lifted the siege and left.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Haizhou again; Li Bao fought them off and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，金人攻樊城，吳拱遣守將翟貴、王進與戰，貴、進俱戰死，金兵亦退。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Jin troops attacked Fancheng; Wu Gong sent defenders Zhai Gui and Wang Jin to fight; Gui and Jin both died in battle and the Jin also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Jin hit Fancheng; Zhai Gui and Wang Jin died fighting and the Jin withdrew.

sentences.zh: 劉錡遣兵渡淮及金人戰，死者十七八。

translations.literal: Liu Qi sent troops across the Huai to fight the Jin; seven or eight in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi's men crossed the Huai and lost seven or eight in ten.

sentences.zh: 金主亮以大軍至廬州城北之五里，築土城以居。

translations.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing with his great army reached five li north of Luzhou city and built an earthen wall to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing camped five li north of Luzhou and threw up an earthen wall.

sentences.zh: 戚方遣將張寶復蔣州。

translations.literal: Qi Fang sent General Zhang Bao to recover Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Fang's Zhang Bao retook Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以金人渝盟告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Jin breach of treaty was announced to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Jin breach was proclaimed to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars.

sentences.zh: 命州縣諭富民捐貲助國。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were ordered to tell wealthy households to donate funds to aid the state.
translations.idiomatic: Counties were told to urge wealthy households to donate to the war effort.

sentences.zh: 劉錡聞王權遁，自淮陰引兵歸揚州。

translations.literal: Liu Qi, hearing Wang Quan had fled, led troops from Huaiyin back to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Wang Quan had run, Liu Qi pulled back from Huaiyin to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金主亮入廬州，王權自昭關遁，金人追至尉子橋，破敵軍統制姚興戰死，權退保和州。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin ruler Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled from Zhaoguan; the Jin pursued to Weizi Bridge; Break-the-Enemy controller Yao Xing died fighting; Quan fell back to defend Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled Zhaoguan; at Weizi Bridge Yao Xing fell; Quan held Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 金州都統制王彥遣統制任天錫出洵陽，復豐陽縣。

translations.literal: Jinzhou overall commander Wang Yan sent controller Ren Tiansi out of Xunyang and recovered Fengyang county.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan's Ren Tiansi left Xunyang and retook Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，帝聞王權敗，召楊存中同宰執議於內殿，陳康伯贊帝定議親征。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the Emperor, hearing Wang Quan was defeated, summoned Yang Cunzhong with the chief ministers to discuss in the inner hall; Chen Kangbo praised the Emperor for fixing on campaigning in person.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, hearing of Wang Quan's defeat, Gaozong called Yang Cunzhong and the councilors within; Chen Kangbo praised his resolve to take the field.

sentences.zh: 武钜遣將荀琛復鄧州。

translations.literal: Wu Ju sent General Xun Chen to recover Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ju's Xun Chen retook Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，任天錫復商洛縣。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Ren Tiansi recovered Shangluo county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Ren Tiansi retook Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 命吳璘趣出兵漢中，葉義問督視江、淮軍馬，中書舍人虞允文參謀軍事。

translations.literal: Wu Lin was ordered to hurry troops out of Hanzhong; Ye Yiwen supervised Jiang and Huai forces; Secretariat drafter Yu Yunwen joined in planning the army.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was urged out of Hanzhong; Ye Yiwen oversaw Jiang and Huai; Yu Yunwen advised on the war.

sentences.zh: 金人犯真州，步軍司統制邵宏淵逆戰於胥浦橋，兵敗，真州陷。

translations.literal: Jin troops attacked Zhenzhou; Infantry Bureau controller Shao Hongyuan met them at Xupu Bridge, was defeated, and Zhenzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Zhenzhou after Shao Hongyuan lost at Xupu Bridge.

sentences.zh: 金人不入城，遂犯揚州。

translations.literal: The Jin did not enter the city but then attacked Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They bypassed the city and struck Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，任天錫復商州，執其守完顏守能。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Ren Tiansi recovered Shangzhou and captured its prefect Wanyan Shouneng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Ren Tiansi retook Shangzhou and seized Wanyan Shouneng.

sentences.zh: 趙撙引兵渡淮。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan led troops across the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以楊存中為禦營宿衛使。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Yang Cunzhong was made Palace Guard commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Yang Cunzhong became Palace Guard commissioner.

sentences.zh: 趙撙復褒信縣。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Baoxin county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan retook Baoxin.

sentences.zh: 王權自和州遁歸，屯於東採石。

translations.literal: Wang Quan fled from Hezhou back and camped at East Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan fled Hezhou to East Caishi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復湯思退觀文殿大學士、充醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Tang Situi was restored as Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture, made commissioner of the Sweet Spring Abbey and concurrent Lecturer-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Tang Situi was restored to Cultivating Culture academician, Sweet Spring commissioner, and Lecturer-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 分行在官吏三之一扈從，餘留行遣常事。

translations.literal: One third of the mobile court's civil officials were to accompany the expedition; the rest remained to handle routine business.
translations.idiomatic: A third of capital officials would accompany the Emperor; the rest kept routine business.

sentences.zh: 金人陷和州。

translations.literal: Jin troops took Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以將士勞於征討，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Day renxu: because the troops were weary in campaign, the Emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Gaozong avoided the main hall and ate sparingly for the troops' sake.

sentences.zh: 劉錡退軍瓜州鎮，金人陷揚州，淮東安撫使劉澤棄城奔泰州。

translations.literal: Liu Qi withdrew to Guazhou town; the Jin took Yangzhou; Huai East pacification commissioner Liu Ze abandoned the city and fled to Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi fell back to Guazhou; the Jin took Yangzhou; Liu Ze fled to Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎劉岑為禦營隨軍都轉運使，李顯忠為禦營先鋒都統制屯蕪湖，主管步軍司李捧為前軍都統制。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Cen was made Palace Guard campaign overall transport commissioner; Li Xianzhong was made Palace Guard vanguard overall commander and camped at Wuhu; director of the Infantry Bureau Li Peng was made forward-army overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Cen became campaign transport commissioner; Li Xianzhong vanguard commander at Wuhu; Li Peng forward-army commander.

sentences.zh: 趙撙復新蔡縣。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Xincai county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan retook Xincai.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，募諸州豪民招槍杖、弓箭手赴 行在。

translations.literal: Day guihai: wealthy men of the prefectures were recruited to raise pike and bowmen for the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, wealthy prefectural households were recruited to raise pikes and bows for court.

sentences.zh: 金人入揚州。

translations.literal: Jin troops entered Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin entered Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 王權自採石夜還建康，

translations.literal: Wang Quan by night returned from Caishi to Jiankang,
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan slipped back from Caishi to Jiankang by night,

sentences.zh: "尋復如採石。

translations.literal: then soon again went to Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: then soon returned to Caishi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復張浚觀文殿大學士、判潭州。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Zhang Jun was restored as Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture and made to judge Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhang Jun was restored to Cultivating Culture academician and sent to judge Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣統制吳挺、向起等及金人戰於德順軍之治平砦，敗之。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent controllers Wu Ting and Xiang Qi and others to fight the Jin at Zhiping Fort in De'shun Army and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin's Wu Ting and Xiang Qi beat the Jin at Zhiping Fort in De'shun Army.

sentences.zh: 趙撙復平興縣。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Pingxing county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan retook Pingxing.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，金人趨瓜州，劉錡遣統領員琦拒之于皂角林，大敗之，斬其統軍高景山。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Jin pressed Guazhou; Liu Qi sent commander Yuan Qi to meet them at Zaojiao Grove and inflicted a great defeat, beheading their commander Gao Jingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, as the Jin pressed Guazhou, Liu Qi's Yuan Qi crushed them at Zaojiao Grove and took Gao Jingshan's head.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李寶遇金舟師於膠西縣陳家島，大敗之，斬完顏鄭家奴等五人。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Li Bao met the Jin fleet at Chen Family Islet in Jiaoxi county and inflicted a great defeat, beheading Wanyan Zhengjianu and four others.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Li Bao destroyed the Jin fleet at Chen Family Islet in Jiaoxi and beheaded Wanyan Zhengjianu and four others.

sentences.zh: 劉錡還鎮江府。

translations.literal: Liu Qi returned to Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi returned to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 趙撙復蔡州，斬其總管楊寓。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Caizhou and beheaded its overall commander Yang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan retook Caizhou and beheaded Yang Yu.

sentences.zh: 分禦營宿衛為五軍。

translations.literal: The Palace Guard was split into five armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Guard was divided into five armies.

sentences.zh: 金人攻秦州，向起、吳挺擊卻之。

translations.literal: Jin troops attacked Qinzhou; Xiang Qi and Wu Ting beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Qinzhou; Xiang Qi and Wu Ting drove them off.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，葉義問至鎮江。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Ye Yiwen reached Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Ye Yiwen reached Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 詔起江、浙、福建諸州強丁赴江上諸軍。

translations.literal: An edict raised strong men from Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian to the river armies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict drafted strong men from Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian to the river armies.

sentences.zh: 武钜復虢州盧氏縣，任天錫復朱陽縣。

translations.literal: Wu Ju recovered Lushi county in Guozhou; Ren Tiansi recovered Zhuyang county.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ju retook Guozhou's Lushi; Ren Tiansi retook Zhuyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，殿中侍御史杜莘老劾內侍張去為，帝不悅，去為致仕，出莘老知遂寧府。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: remonstrance officer Du Xinlao impeached the eunuch Zhang Quwei; the Emperor was displeased; Quwei retired; Xinlao was sent out as Suining prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Du Xinlao impeached Zhang Quwei; Gaozong was displeased; Quwei retired and Xinlao was sent to Suining.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳朔，邵宏淵遣統領崔皋及金人戰於定山，敗之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi new moon: Shao Hongyuan sent commander Cui Gao to fight the Jin at Dingshan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jisi new moon: Shao Hongyuan's Cui Gao beat the Jin at Dingshan.

sentences.zh: 任天錫復虢州，守將蕭信遁去。

translations.literal: Ren Tiansi recovered Guozhou; the Jin prefect Xiao Xin fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Tiansi retook Guozhou; Xiao Xin fled.

sentences.zh: 庚午，通州守臣崔邦弼棄城去。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Tongzhou prefect Cui Bangbi abandoned the city and left.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Tongzhou's Cui Bangbi abandoned his post.

sentences.zh: 辛未，成閔引兵發應城縣，援淮西。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Cheng Min led troops from Yingcheng county to aid Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Cheng Min marched from Yingcheng to aid Huai West.

sentences.zh: 遣權吏部侍郎汪應辰詣浙東措置海道。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yingchen was sent to arrange the sea route in Zhe East.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yingchen was sent to organize the Zhe East sea route.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以張浚判建康府。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Zhang Jun was made to judge Jiankang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Jun was assigned Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 召王權赴行在，以李顯忠代將。

translations.literal: Wang Quan was summoned to the mobile court; Li Xianzhong replaced him in command.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan was recalled; Li Xianzhong took his command.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵為池州都統制。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan was made Chizhou overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan became Chizhou overall commander.

sentences.zh: 金人犯瓜州，鎮江中軍統制劉汜戰敗走，權都統制李橫亦遁。

translations.literal: Jin troops attacked Guazhou; Zhenjiang central-army controller Liu Si was defeated and fled; acting overall commander Li Heng also fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin hit Guazhou; Liu Si fled in defeat and Li Heng with him.

sentences.zh: 金人鐵騎奄至江上，統制魏俊、王方死之。

translations.literal: Jin iron cavalry suddenly reached the river; controllers Wei Jun and Wang Fang died.
translations.idiomatic: Jin iron cavalry swept to the riverbank; Wei Jun and Wang Fang fell.

sentences.zh: 葉義問惶怖欲退走，復趨建康。

translations.literal: Ye Yiwen in panic wished to withdraw but then hurried to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Yiwen nearly fled in panic, then rushed to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 金人游騎至無為軍，守臣韓髦棄城走。

translations.literal: Jin raiders reached Wuwei Army; prefect Han Mao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jin raiders reached Wuwei; Han Mao fled.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，淮甯府民陳亨祖執同知完顏耶魯，以其城來歸。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Huaining prefecture commoner Chen Hengzu seized Vice Prefect Wanyan Yelu and brought the city in.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Chen Hengzu of Huaining seized Wanyan Yelu and surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 趙撙引兵去，蔡州復陷。

translations.literal: Zhao Zan led troops away; Caizhou again fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zan withdrew and Caizhou fell again.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，池州統制官崔定等復入無為軍。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Chizhou controller Cui Ding and others re-entered Wuwei Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Cui Ding of Chizhou re-entered Wuwei Army.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金主亮臨江築壇，刑馬祭天，期以翌日南渡。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Jin ruler Hailing built an altar by the river, slaughtered a horse to sacrifice to Heaven, and set the next day to cross south.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Hailing sacrificed a horse by the river and vowed to cross the next day.

sentences.zh: 丙子，虞允文督建康諸軍統制官張振、王琪、時俊、戴皋等以舟師拒金主亮於東採石，戰勝，卻之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yu Yunwen directed Jiankang fleet controllers Zhang Zhen, Wang Qi, Shi Jun, and Dai Gao and others with warships to meet Hailing at East Caishi, fought, won, and drove him back.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yu Yunwen's fleet met Hailing at East Caishi, won, and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 崔定復巢縣，任天錫復上津、商洛二縣。

translations.literal: Cui Ding recovered Chao county; Ren Tiansi recovered Shangjin and Shangluo counties.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Ding retook Chao; Ren Tiansi retook Shangjin and Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，虞允文遣水軍統制盛新以舟師擊金人于楊林河口，又敗之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Yu Yunwen sent naval controller Sheng Xin with warships to strike the Jin at Yanglin River mouth and again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Yu Yunwen's Sheng Xin beat the Jin again at Yanglin mouth.

sentences.zh: 金主亮焚其舟而去。

translations.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing burned his boats and left.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing burned his boats and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王彥遣將楊堅復欒川縣。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Yan sent General Yang Jian to recover Luanchuan county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Yan's Yang Jian retook Luanchuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以湯思退為行宮留守。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Tang Situi was made mobile-court resident.

sentences.zh: 虛恨蠻犯嘉州籠蓬堡，官軍大敗，副將鄭祥等為所殺。

translations.literal: The Xuhuaiman attacked Jiazhou's Longpeng fort; government troops were badly beaten and deputy commander Zheng Xiang and others were killed.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuhuaiman struck Longpeng fort in Jiazhou; government troops were routed and deputy commander Zheng Xiang and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金主亮引軍趨淮東。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Jin ruler Hailing led his army toward Huai east.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jin Emperor Hailing marched toward Huai east.

sentences.zh: 癸未，吳璘病，自仙人原還興州，留姚仲節制軍事，虞允文自採石率李捧一軍及戈船如鎮江備敵。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wu Lin fell ill, returned from Xianrenyuan to Xing prefecture, left Yao Zhong to control the army, and Yu Yunwen from Caishi led Li Peng's army and war junks to Zhenjiang against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wu Lin fell ill, left Xianrenyuan for Xing, put Yao Zhong in charge of the army, and Yu Yunwen from Caishi sent Li Peng's force and war junks to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，贈姚興、魏俊、王方官。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Yao Xing, Wei Jun, and Wang Fang were posthumously enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yao Xing, Wei Jun, and Wang Fang received posthumous enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 金主亮至揚州。

translations.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing reached Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Emperor Hailing reached Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，貸劉汜死、英州編管。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Liu Si was spared death and banished to registered supervision at Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Liu Si was spared execution and banished to Ying supervision.

sentences.zh: 江州統制李貴、忠義首領孟俊復順昌府，金州將邢進復華州。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou overall commander Li Gui and loyalist leader Meng Jun recovered Shunchang prefecture; Jin prefecture commander Xing Jin recovered Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou commander Li Gui and loyalist Meng Jun retook Shunchang; Jin officer Xing Jin retook Hua prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜戰士帛，給其家薪炭。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: silk was granted to fighting men and fuel given their families.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, warriors received silk grants and their families were given fuel.

sentences.zh: 任天錫復陝州。

translations.literal: Ren Tiansi recovered Shan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Tiansi retook Shan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，劉錡以疾罷，以禦營宿衛中軍統制劉銳權鎮江都統制。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Liu Qi was dismissed for illness; Imperial Guard central-army controller Liu Rui was made acting Zhenjiang overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Liu Qi left office for illness; central-army controller Liu Rui became acting Zhenjiang commander.

sentences.zh: 成閔自京西還建康，遂如鎮江。

translations.literal: Cheng Min returned from Jing west to Jiankang and then went to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Min came back from Jing west to Jiankang and then to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，吳璘復力疾上仙人原。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wu Lin again forced himself up to Xianrenyuan despite illness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wu Lin dragged himself back to Xianrenyuan despite illness.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王權貸死、瓊州編管。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Wang Quan was spared death and banished to registered supervision at Qiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Quan was spared execution and banished to Qiong supervision.

sentences.zh: 李寶泛海南歸。

translations.literal: Li Bao sailed the sea south and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao returned by sea from the south.

sentences.zh: 金人復攻陝州，任天錫破走之。

translations.literal: The Jin again attacked Shan prefecture; Ren Tiansi routed and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Shan again; Ren Tiansi beat them back.

sentences.zh: 復犯襄陽，統制官李勝等拒卻之，復通化軍。

translations.literal: They again attacked Xiangyang; controller Li Sheng and others repelled them and restored Tonghua army.
translations.idiomatic: They struck Xiangyang again; controller Li Sheng and others drove them off and restored Tonghua army.

sentences.zh: 王彥遣將楊堅、黨清至西京長水縣及金人戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Wang Yan sent generals Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui county west of the Western Capital and fought the Jin, defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yang Jian and Dang Qing to Changshui west of the Western Capital, fought the Jin, and won.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復長水縣。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Changshui county was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Changshui county was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以成閔為鎮江都統制、淮東制置使、京東西路河北東路淮北泗宿州招討使，李顯忠為淮西制置使、京畿河北西路淮北壽亳州招討使，吳拱為湖北京西制置使、京西北路招討使。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Cheng Min was made Zhenjiang overall commander, Huai east commissioner, and commissioner for pacification and reconquest of Jing west, Jing east, Hebei east, and north of the Huai including Si and Su prefectures; Li Xianzhong Huai west commissioner and commissioner for Jingji, Hebei west, and north of the Huai including Shou and Bo prefectures; Wu Gong Hubei and Jing west commissioner and commissioner for Jing northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Cheng Min became Zhenjiang commander, Huai east commissioner, and reconquest commissioner for Jing west and east, Hebei east, and Huai-north Si and Su; Li Xianzhong became Huai west commissioner and reconquest commissioner for Jingji, Hebei west, and Huai-north Shou and Bo; Wu Gong became Hubei–Jing west commissioner and Jing northwest reconquest commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，武钜遣鄉兵總轄杜隱等復嵩州。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Wu Ju sent militia commander Du Yin and others to recover Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wu Ju's militia commander Du Yin and others retook Song prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，金人陷泰州。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Jin took Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Jin captured Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，金人弑其主亮於揚州龜山寺。

translations.literal: That day the Jin slew their ruler Hailing at Guishan Temple in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Jin killed Emperor Hailing at Guishan Temple in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金都督府遣人持檄詣鎮江軍中議和。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the Jin command headquarters sent men with a proclamation to the Zhenjiang army to discuss peace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the Jin command sent envoys with a peace proclamation to the Zhenjiang army.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，趙撙夜襲蔡州，復入其城。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai new moon: Zhao Zong by night raided Cai prefecture and re-entered its walls.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Zhao Zong night-raided Cai prefecture and re-entered the city.

sentences.zh: 王彥遣兵復福昌縣。

translations.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to recover Fuchang county.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent troops to retake Fuchang county.

sentences.zh: 庚子，楊存中及虞允文渡江至瓜州察金兵。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed the river to Guazhou to inspect Jin troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed to Guazhou to scout the Jin.

sentences.zh: 金人犯漢南之茨湖，鄂州軍士史俊登其舟，獲一將，諸軍繼進，遂擊卻之。

translations.literal: The Jin attacked Cihu in south Han; Ezhou soldier Shi Jun boarded their boat, seized a general, the armies pressed on, and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Cihu in south Han; Ezhou soldier Shi Jun boarded a boat, captured a general, the armies followed up, and beat them back.

sentences.zh: 楊椿夜攻金人，殺其帥高定山，復廬州。

translations.literal: Yang Chun by night attacked the Jin, killed their commander Gao Dingshan, and recovered Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chun night-attacked the Jin, killed commander Gao Dingshan, and retook Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以李寶為靖海軍節度使、浙西通泰海州沿海制置使、京東東路招討使。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Li Bao was made military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, coastal commissioner for Zhe west and Tong, Tai, and Haizhou, and reconquest commissioner for Jing east.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Bao became Jinghai military commissioner, Zhe-west coastal commissioner for Tong, Tai, and Hai, and Jing-east reconquest commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金統軍劉萼聞茨湖敗，亦退師。

translations.literal: Jin overall commander Liu E, hearing of the defeat at Cihu, also withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: Jin commander Liu E, hearing of Cihu's defeat, also withdrew.

sentences.zh: 王彥遣將閻玘復澠池縣。

translations.literal: Wang Yan sent general Yan Qi to recover Mianchi county.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Yan Qi to retake Mianchi county.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，天有白氣。

translations.literal: Day renyin: white vapor appeared in the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, white vapor appeared in the sky.

sentences.zh: 以趙密為行宮在城都總管。

translations.literal: Zhao Mi was made overall commander of the traveling palace within the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Mi was made in-city traveling-palace overall commander.

sentences.zh: 成閔渡江之揚州。

translations.literal: Cheng Min crossed the river to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Min crossed the river to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命諸路招討司率兵進討，互相應援，沿江諸大帥條陳恢復事宜。

translations.literal: Day guimao: reconquest offices on every route were ordered to advance together with mutual support; great commanders along the river were to submit plans for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, every reconquest office was told to advance in mutual support; Yangtze commanders were to submit recovery plans.

sentences.zh: 復岳州舊名。

translations.literal: Yue prefecture's old name was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Yue prefecture's former name was restored.

sentences.zh: 右軍統領沙世堅入泰州。

translations.literal: Right-army controller Sha Shijian entered Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Right-army controller Sha Shijian entered Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，虞允文自鎮江入見。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Yu Yunwen from Zhenjiang had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yu Yunwen came from Zhenjiang for audience.

sentences.zh: 均州統領昝朝復鄧州。

translations.literal: Jun prefecture controller Zan Chao recovered Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jun controller Zan Chao retook Deng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，張浚至慈湖，命李顯忠引兵渡江。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zhang Jun reached Cihu and ordered Li Xianzhong to lead troops across the river.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhang Jun reached Cihu and told Li Xianzhong to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 丙午，淮東統制王選復楚州。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Huai east controller Wang Xuan recovered Chu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Huai east controller Wang Xuan retook Chu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，杜隱等入河南府。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Du Yin and others entered Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Du Yin and others entered Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吳拱遣統制牛宏入汝州。

translations.literal: Wu Gong sent controller Niu Hong into Ru prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Gong sent controller Niu Hong into Ru prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，帝發臨安，建王從行。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Emperor set out from Lin'an; the Prince of Jian accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the emperor left Lin'an with the Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金人渡淮北去。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Jin crossed north of the Huai and departed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Jin crossed north of the Huai and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 壬子，次平江。

translations.literal: Day renzi: he halted at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, he stopped at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 罷督視府。

translations.literal: The Supervisory Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Supervisory Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 虞允文還至鎮江。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen returned to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen returned to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，淮東統制劉銳、陳敏引兵入泗州。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Huai east controllers Liu Rui and Chen Min led troops into Si prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Huai east controllers Liu Rui and Chen Min entered Si prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鄂州統制楊欽以舟師追敗金人于洪澤鎮。

translations.literal: Ezhou controller Yang Qin with a fleet pursued and defeated the Jin at Hongze town.
translations.idiomatic: Ezhou controller Yang Qin's fleet pursued and beat the Jin at Hongze town.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，江北金兵盡去，李顯忠復入和州。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Jin troops north of the river were all gone; Li Xianzhong re-entered He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, north-of-river Jin forces were gone; Li Xianzhong re-entered He prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣將復水洛城。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent generals to recover Shuiluo city.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin sent generals to retake Shuiluo city.

sentences.zh: 金人復破汝州，牛宏敗走。

translations.literal: The Jin again took Ru prefecture; Niu Hong was beaten and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin retook Ru prefecture; Niu Hong was routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: he halted at Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, he stopped at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，吳璘遣將拔金人治平砦。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Wu Lin sent generals to storm the Jin's Zhiping fort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wu Lin's generals stormed the Jin Zhiping fort.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，曲赦新復州軍。

translations.literal: Day renxu: newly recovered prefectures and armies received a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, newly recovered prefectures and armies received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 甲子，降淮南、京西、湖北雜犯死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: death sentences and below for miscellaneous offenses in Huainan, Jing west, and Hubei were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, death sentences and lesser crimes in Huainan, Jing west, and Hubei were commuted.

sentences.zh: 賞採石功，進統制張振、時俊等官。

translations.literal: Caishi merit was rewarded; controllers Zhang Zhen, Shi Jun, and others were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Caishi victors were rewarded; controllers Zhang Zhen, Shi Jun, and others were promoted.

sentences.zh: 金潁、壽二州巡檢高顯以壽春府來降。

translations.literal: Jin patrol inspectors Gao Xian of Ying and Shou prefectures surrendered Shouchun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin patrol inspectors Gao Xian of Ying and Shou surrendered Shouchun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命諸道籍鄉兵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: every route was ordered to register militia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, every route was told to register militia.

sentences.zh: 初，王友直、王任聚兵，嘗命友直為天雄軍節度使，任為天平軍節度使。

translations.literal: Earlier Wang Youzhi and Wang Ren had gathered troops; Youzhi had been made military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and Ren of the Tianping Army.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Youzhi and Wang Ren had raised forces; Youzhi was made Tianxiong commissioner and Ren Tianping commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金主褒既立，下令散其眾，友直等自壽春來歸。

translations.literal: After Jin Emperor Shizong took the throne, he ordered their bands dispersed; Youzhi and the rest came in from Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin Emperor Shizong enthroned, he ordered their bands broken up; Youzhi and others came in from Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 是月，金主知亮已死，遂趨燕京。

translations.literal: That month, learning Hailing was dead, the Jin ruler hurried to Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: That month, learning Hailing was dead, the Jin emperor hurried to Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春正月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year, spring, first month, day wuchen new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-second year, spring, wuchen new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 帝在鎮江。

translations.literal: The Emperor was at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，金人犯壽春府，忠義將劉泰戰死，金兵引去。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Jin attacked Shouchun prefecture; loyalist Liu Tai died fighting and the Jin withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Jin struck Shouchun; loyalist Liu Tai was killed in battle and the Jin withdrew.

sentences.zh: 庚午，發鎮江府。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: he set out from Zhenjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, he left Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至建康府，張浚入見。

translations.literal: Day renshen: he reached Jiankang prefecture; Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, he reached Jiankang; Zhang Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 丙子，祧翼祖主於夾室。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the spirit tablet of the Wing Ancestor was moved to a side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Wing Ancestor's tablet was moved to a side chamber.

sentences.zh: 己卯，李顯忠引兵還建康。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Li Xianzhong led troops back to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Li Xianzhong brought his army back to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷郡守年七十者。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: prefects aged seventy were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, prefects aged seventy were removed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，金人復犯蔡州，趙撙力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Jin again attacked Cai prefecture; Zhao Zong fought hard and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Jin struck Cai again; Zhao Zong fought them off.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，權知東平府耿京遣其將賈瑞、掌書記辛棄疾來奏事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: acting Dongping prefect Geng Jing sent his general Jia Rui and secretary Xin Qiji to report at court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, acting Dongping prefect Geng Jing sent general Jia Rui and secretary Xin Qiji to report at court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，金主遣其臣高忠建等來告嗣位。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Jin ruler sent his ministers Gao Zhongjian and others to announce his succession.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Jin emperor sent Gao Zhongjian and others to announce his succession.

sentences.zh: 以耿京為天平軍節度使、知東平府。

translations.literal: Geng Jing was made military commissioner of the Tianping Army and prefect of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Jing became Tianping military commissioner and Dongping prefect.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔新復州縣搜訪仗節死義之士。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict ordered newly recovered prefectures and counties to seek out those who died holding office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, newly recovered districts were told to seek out martyred officials.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以楊存中為江、淮、荊、襄路宣撫使，虞允文副之。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Yang Cunzhong was made commissioner for pacification of the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Xiang routes; Yu Yunwen was made his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Yang Cunzhong became pacification commissioner for Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Xiang; Yu Yunwen was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 給事中金安節、中書舍人劉珙繳奏再上，乃改命存中措置兩淮。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretariat drafter Jin Anjie and Secretariat drafter Liu Gui resubmitted the memorial; only then was Cunzhong changed to disposition of the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters Jin Anjie and Liu Gui resubmitted; Cunzhong was then changed to disposition of the two Huai only.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌朔，罷借兩浙、江、淮坊場淨利錢。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu new moon: borrowing against licensed-shop net profits in the two Zhe, Jiang, and Huai circuits was ended.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuxu new moon: borrowing against Zhe, Jiang, and Huai licensed-shop profits was ended.

sentences.zh: 以虞允文為兵部尚書、川陝宣諭使，措置招軍市馬及與吳璘議事。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen was made Minister of War and Sichuan-Shaanxi commissioner for pacification, to handle recruiting, horse purchase, and affairs with Wu Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen became Minister of War and Sichuan-Shaanxi commissioner to handle recruiting, horse buying, and affairs with Wu Lin.

sentences.zh: 庚子，興州統領惠逢等復河州。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Xing prefecture controller Hui Feng and others recovered He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Xing controller Hui Feng and others retook He prefecture.

sentences.zh: 振兩淮饑民。

translations.literal: Famine victims in the two Huai were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Two-Huai famine victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金人犯汝州，守將王宣逆戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Jin attacked Ru prefecture; defending commander Wang Xuan met them and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Jin struck Ru; defender Wang Xuan met them and won.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，帝發建康。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Emperor set out from Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the emperor left Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 惠逢復積石軍，又克來羌城。

translations.literal: Hui Feng recovered Jishi army and also took Laicang city.
translations.idiomatic: Hui Feng retook Jishi army and also captured Laicang city.

sentences.zh: 丁未，劉錡薨。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Liu Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Liu Qi died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王宣及金人再戰於汝州。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wang Xuan and the Jin fought again at Ru prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Xuan and the Jin fought again at Ru.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金人全師來攻，宣敗績，棄去。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Jin came in full force; Xuan was beaten and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Jin came in full strength; Xuan was routed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金人復犯順昌府，孟新拒卻之，尋亦棄去。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Jin again attacked Shunchang prefecture; Meng Xin repelled them and soon withdrew as well.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Jin struck Shunchang again; Meng Xin beat them back and soon withdrew too.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賞蔡州功，趙撙等進官有差。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Cai prefecture merit was rewarded; Zhao Zong and others were advanced in rank by degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Cai victors were rewarded; Zhao Zong and others were promoted by degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，至臨安府。

translations.literal: Day yimao: he reached Lin'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he reached Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 興元都統制姚仲攻鞏州不下，退守甘穀城，遂引兵圍德順軍。

translations.literal: Xingyuan overall commander Yao Zhong attacked Gong prefecture without success, fell back to Gangu city, and then led troops to besiege Deshun army.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyuan commander Yao Zhong failed to take Gong, fell back to Gangu city, and besieged Deshun army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金人犯蔡州。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin attacked Cai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Jin attacked Cai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 趙撙擊卻之。

translations.literal: Zhao Zong struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zong beat them back.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復引兵來攻，撙又敗之，金兵遁去。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: they came again; Zong again defeated them and the Jin fled.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, they returned; Zong defeated them again and the Jin fled.

sentences.zh: 王彥遣將馬貴斷河中南橋，金兵來攻，貴戰敗之。

translations.literal: Wang Yan sent general Ma Gui to cut the south bridge on the Yellow River; the Jin came to attack and Gui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent Ma Gui to cut the Yellow River's south bridge; the Jin attacked and Gui defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔軍士戰死者祿其家一年，傷重而死于營者半之。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict granted one year's salary to families of soldiers killed in battle; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, families of soldiers killed in battle received one year's salary; half for those who died in camp of severe wounds.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，王宣及右軍副將汲靖敗金人于蔡州確山縣。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Wang Xuan and right-army deputy Ji Jing defeated the Jin at Queshan county in Cai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Wang Xuan and right-army deputy Ji Jing beat the Jin at Queshan in Cai.

sentences.zh: 趙撙棄蔡州。

translations.literal: Zhao Zong abandoned Cai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zong abandoned Cai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，金人復取之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Jin took it again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Jin retook it.

sentences.zh: 姚仲遣副將趙銓攻下鎮戎軍，金同知渭州秦弼及其子嵩來歸。

translations.literal: Yao Zhong sent deputy Zhao Quan to take Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei prefecture commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song came over.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zhong's deputy Zhao Quan took Zhenrong army; Jin acting Wei commissioner Qin Bi and his son Song defected.

sentences.zh: 王彥遣兵救陝州，遇金人於虢州東，敗之，金兵引去。

translations.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to relieve Shan prefecture, met the Jin east of Guo prefecture, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan sent relief to Shan, met the Jin east of Guo, defeated them, and the Jin withdrew.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吳珙遣將復永安軍、永寧、福昌、長水三縣。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Gong sent generals to recover Yong'an army and the three counties Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Gong's generals retook Yong'an army and Yongning, Fuchang, and Changshui counties.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，金人破河州，屠其城。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guiyou: the Jin took He prefecture and slaughtered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guiyou: the Jin took He prefecture and massacred the city.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命楊存中、李顯忠固守新復州軍，量度進討。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Yang Cunzhong and Li Xianzhong were ordered to hold newly recovered prefectures and armies and weigh advance.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yang Cunzhong and Li Xianzhong were told to hold new gains and weigh an advance.

sentences.zh: 丙子，姚仲遣將復原州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yao Zhong sent generals to recover Yuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yao Zhong's generals retook Yuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祔欽宗主於太廟。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Emperor Qinzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Emperor Qinzong's tablet was placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸未，振淮南歸正人。

translations.literal: Day guimao: returnees in Huainan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Huainan returnees were relieved.

sentences.zh: 金人犯虢州。

translations.literal: The Jin attacked Guo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Guo prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吳璘遣楊從儀等攻拔大散關，分兵據和尚原，金人走寶雞。

translations.literal: Wu Lin sent Yang Congyi and others to storm Dasan Pass, divided troops to hold Heshang plain, and the Jin fled to Baoji.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin sent Yang Congyi and others to storm Dasan Pass, posted troops on Heshang plain, and the Jin fled to Baoji.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，給張浚錢十九萬緡，造沿江諸軍戰艦。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhang Jun was granted 190,000 strings to build war junks for armies along the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Jun received 190,000 strings to build war junks for river armies.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，王剛破金人於海州。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Wang Gang defeated the Jin at Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Wang Gang defeated the Jin at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，楊椿罷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Yang Chun was dismissed.
